name: MSR India Limited
summary: MSR India Limited manufactures and sells copper water bottles, vermicelli, pasta, atta, and special purpose components for ISRO in India. The company offers copper rods, wires, bussbars, flats, and strips; and forged contact and power transmission terminals, rotating and grip contact, contact clips, and copper components. It also offers FMCG related products. The company exports its products. MSR India Limited was incorporated in 2002 and is based in Hyderabad, India.
